correctness.rationale: For u=f+xg, multiplication is the triangular 2x2 R-matrix with diagonal f and off-diagonal g. Powers give k f^{k-1}g. In characteristic p|k it vanishes; otherwise DVR Smith valuations are (k-1)a+min(a,b) and (k+1)a-min(a,b), with explicit zero-series boundary treatment. Modulo y^n, the rank of a valuation-d scalar is max(n-d,0), yielding the exact power-rank formulas. Double differences reconstruct all Jordan partitions. Valuation fiber cardinalities w_n(a)w_n(b) prove the exact polynomial. Exhaustive independent construction/rank checking passed 12 q,n combinations, including F4. Strong-type count follows from u^n=n x f^{n-1}g and power ranks. Computations test finite cases only.

value.rationale: The Jordan partition of multiplication by a radical element is a canonical invariant of an Artinian algebra. This theorem completely enumerates every such partition and every power-rank profile over a naturally varying two-generator complete-intersection family and all finite characteristics, including nonhomogeneous elements. It yields an exact arithmetic cut in the maximal Jordan stratum rather than just its known existence condition, so the refined finite-field frequencies can support quantitative Jordan-locus and modular Lefschetz investigations. Neither a routine known table nor a parameter-renaming exercise in the inspected sources.
